command: $p=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^(hw_server|cs_server|vivado|xsdb|xsim|vitis|vitis_cli)\.exe$' } | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{pid=$_.ProcessId;parent_pid=$_.ParentProcessId;name=$_.Name;exe=$_.ExecutablePath;creation_filetime_utc=$_.CreationDate.ToUniversalTime().ToFileTimeUtc()} }; $c=Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3121 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object State,LocalAddress,LocalPort,RemoteAddress,RemotePort,OwningProcess; $u=Get-CimInstance Win32_SerialPort | Select-Object DeviceID,Name,PNPDeviceID; [pscustomobject]@{processes=@($p);port3121=@($c);uart=@($u)} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 -Compress

uart.Name: Silicon Labs CP210x USB to UART Bridge (COM4)

basis: Only the root task operates the board under the user authorization; latest target state is the saved sample000 ACK_IDLE epoch1, CPU0 stopped and cleanup successful.
